# H1 open Yang--Mills handoff

These are genuine open research obligations. They are not completed by the
finite H1 theorem.

Stages 54--58 now supply finite normalized-kernel, Harnack, robust-envelope,
weight-cocycle, and basin-audit interfaces for these tasks. No checkbox below
is changed: the new stages prove the abstract mechanisms and countermodels,
not the required boundary-, volume-, and cutoff-uniform nonlinear `SU(2)`
premises.

## Y1 -- physical transfer object

- [ ] Freeze the finite SU(2) regulator, temporal slicing, boundary algebra,
  retained state, and positive-mass history space.
- [ ] Construct the exact normalized nonlinear transfer or exploration kernel.
- [ ] Prove boundary gauge covariance and reflection compatibility.
- [ ] Distinguish the actual temporal transfer from the RG/exploration kernel.

## Y2 -- vacuum or Lyapunov eigenweight

- [ ] Prove compactness/positivity hypotheses needed for a strictly positive
  finite-volume principal eigenfunction.
- [ ] If using the temporal route, identify the eigenfunction with the
  reflection-positive vacuum boundary amplitude.
- [ ] If using the exploration route, label the Perron vector only as a
  Lyapunov weight.
- [ ] Compare the physical candidate with inverse boundary partition weights.

## Y3 -- uniformity

- [ ] Prove volume- and cutoff-uniform control of inverse-amplitude ratios on
  every retained chart.
- [ ] Prove a uniform root-state weight moment.
- [ ] Control histories with small but positive mass.
- [ ] Exclude weights whose definition uses clustering, confinement, or a
  pre-existing mass gap.

## Y4 -- normalized bad rows

- [ ] Prove the full conditional partition normalizer uniformly in boundary
  state.
- [ ] Prove the continuous good-chart and chart-complement rows.
- [ ] Prove center, cut/orbit, and compositionally complete integer-topology
  rows.
- [ ] Bound cross-channel persistence and tunneling.
- [ ] Establish `QV <= qV` with `q < 0.0027927080803578997` strictly.

## Y5 -- stability and reconstruction

- [ ] Prove the retained state and weight survive one additional block step.
- [ ] Establish repeated physical-unit contraction.
- [ ] Transport a state-separating observable core.
- [ ] Construct the continuum Yang--Mills theory and verify OS axioms.
- [ ] Convert uniform temporal rigidity into the Hamiltonian spectral gap.
